svg.title: Diagram 8. MVP-M meeting session (F2, SC-3): consent, REC indicator, You and Others tracks, journal, local STT, chips, directed chips, memory writer, SessionGuard stop policy and mic contention
svg.desc: Part 1 is a sequence for one meeting session. The user starts a session; T12 shows the notice if its version changed and the attestation with no default; the user can turn on Include call audio and copy the disclosure; T12 writes the consent record. R11 shows the REC indicator and the session starts only after it shows. R2 opens the You track and, if on, the Others track with a 5 s zero-buffer check, and writes the encrypted journal with 60 s rotation. R4 transcribes 15-20 s segments locally; transcripts commit locally and the journal is deleted within 5 min. The router (agent first step, classifier fallback) handles micro-batches of up to 3 segments or 2 s: a question with confidence 0.7 or more becomes an Ask Genie chip, a segment that names another MOG becomes a chip on that MOG, and Others-track speech never asks. Nothing goes to Genie automatically (BC1). A chip click or a user-picked moment or summary asks Genie. A PTT during the session becomes a directed segment. The MemoryWriter runs every 10 min or 40 utterances, and approved definitions can become DRAFT UC Pages. Part 2 is the SessionGuard stop policy. Part 3 is the mic lease priority.

g.text: monotonic clock, values from D27 / PolicyStore
Panic key: all capture closed <= 200 ms
Input device lost, no replacement in 10 s
Mic permission revoked / 2 s zero buffers
4 h hard ceiling (admin 1-8 h), no extend
Block timer: soft cap 60 min, extend 30 min
5 min before the new block ends
The 4 h ceiling wins over any extension.
PTT 120 s hold stop and 5 min hands-free
Screen lock / user switch: pause, mic closed
Others track all-zero for 5 s: fix-it UI,
Crypto-shred + unlink audio <= 5 min after commit
(<= 24 h if the commit fails; journal rotates every 60 s)
